follow-on: the §7 gate command carries PYTHONPATH=$PWD alone, which does not reach packages/imas-alambic/src, so a run exactly as written imports the main checkout's imas_alambic rather than the worktree's. The reviewed worker appended the worktree src to PYTHONPATH and said so; the plan's command should name the engine src so the gate measures the node's own tree.

item_verdicts.write_paths: git show --name-only c2db8bdd lists the evidence fragment, the two pyproject.toml files, README.md, __init__.py, cli.py, pulse_writer.py (rename of pulse_mint.py), test_cli.py, test_engine_imports.py and test_pulse_writer.py (rename of test_pulse_mint.py), every one inside the declared fence; docs/figures/jt60sa-facility-mint/jtfm-verb-write is declared but untouched, which a pure rename has no figure to fill.

justifications.durability: test_cli.py is added and the negative control proves it fires when the command is re-registered as mint (EXIT=1, an id the head arm does not fail), which I reproduced under my own mutation; the rename itself is covered by the grep gate, which was reproduced clean across packages, imas_ambix, tests, scripts and both pyproject.toml files. A no-behaviour rename has little else to guard.
justifications.evidence: botch-free reproduction: head gate 1 failed/27 passed EXIT=1 and base gate 1 failed/26 passed EXIT=1, both from my own extraction of the revision, not the worker's tree; grep gate clean; --help lists write and its three options. No new failure is attributable to this node as added_failure_ids is empty: the one failing id changes only because the test module and test were renamed, and the assertion and root cause are identical in kind at both arms (magnetics homogeneous_time 0).
justifications.fit: the diff is a clean, complete rename: every mint-named public symbol is renamed in one pass, docstrings and the module header describe writing, no mint spelling survives in source, and the commit carries a conventional subject with a mechanism body and no plan identifiers; no abbreviation or half-renamed symbol is left behind.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the plan paragraph names this change clause for clause and the diff matches each one, including the rename set, the moved test module, the added test_cli.py and the two pyproject edits; the plan's own done-when is met for --help, grep and ruff, and its pytest clause is red only by a pre-existing failure the plan already records elsewhere.
justifications.reuse: no abstraction is added; the rename reuses the existing structures unchanged and the new test_cli.py uses click's runner rather than introducing any fixture or helper.
justifications.scope_discipline: only the ten declared paths are touched; no plan, index, sprint state or figure is edited, and the plan's own 'records keep the word' rule is honoured (the fragment keeps mint only inside the gate string it records).
